source: probe.py (scripted button tests) + Claude Code driving play.py through the intro, Oak's lab and the first rival battle

dropped_buttons.reason: Overworld: opens the START menu (POKEMON/ITEM/name/SAVE/OPTION/EXIT) and blocks walking until B is pressed. A random policy then presses A inside it and wanders into submenus. Pure time sink for the RL agent.
No effect in the overworld (only 11 WRAM bytes change, no state change). Only used to reorder items in menus.

contexts.name: overworld
contexts.how_to_detect: env.context() == 'overworld': wIsInBattle (0xD057) == 0 and no window-border tile 0x79 anywhere in wTileMap (0xC3A0-0xC507). Note: scripted cutscenes (e.g. Oak walking you to the lab) also read as overworld; input is ignored then.

buttons.up/down/left/right: Walk one tile per press (with 8-frame hold). Blocked by walls/objects: position doesn't change but the player turns to face that way.
buttons.a: Interact with the tile you're facing (people, signs, the SNES, Poke Balls). Opens a text window.
buttons.start: Opens the START menu; 1 B press closes it.

contexts.name: window (dialogue or menu)
contexts.how_to_detect: env.context() == 'window': tile 0x79 (box top-left corner) present in wTileMap. Dialogue box sits at tile row 12; START menu at column 10 of row 0.

buttons.a: Advance dialogue / select the highlighted menu item. YES/NO prompts default to YES.
buttons.b: Advance dialogue too; in YES/NO prompts selects NO; closes menus.

contexts.name: battle
contexts.how_to_detect: wIsInBattle (0xD057) != 0 (1 = wild, 2 = trainer). Enemy HP is 0xCFE6-0xCFE7 (big-endian).

buttons.a: Main menu is a 2x2 grid FIGHT/PKMN (top) ITEM/RUN (bottom), cursor starts on FIGHT. A on FIGHT opens the move list with the first move highlighted; A again uses it. Mashing A = always use move 1, which won the first rival battle (Charmander SCRATCH vs Squirtle) in 108 presses.
buttons.b: Advances battle text; backs out of the move list to the main menu.
buttons.up/down/left/right: Move the cursor in the 2x2 menu (wCurrentMenuItem 0xCC26 = row; 0xCC25 = cursor column) or the move list.
buttons.danger: RUN in a trainer battle prints 'No! There's no running from a trainer battle!' and wastes presses.

manual.movement: One tile per press with step(hold_frames=8, wait_frames=24). A press into a wall only turns the player. Moving off a door/stairs tile changes map_id (Red's room 38 -> 1F 37 -> Pallet Town 0 -> Oak's Lab 40). Position (0xD362 x, 0xD361 y) is per-map, so novelty must be keyed on (map_id, x, y).
reward_ideas: Exploration: +1 for each new (map_id, x, y) tile. The main driver early on, as in PWhiddy's PokemonRedExperiments.
New map: bonus for each first visit to a map_id (Pallet 0, Route 1 12, Viridian 1, ...).
Party level sum (0xD18C + stride 0x2C): reward increases. Rival win took Charmander 5 -> 6.
Battle outcome: penalty when all party HP hits 0 (blackout); small reward for dealing damage (drop in 0xCFE6-7).
Event flags (wEventFlags 0xD747..) once we want story progress beyond exploration.
pitfalls: Facing an object and mashing A loops the same dialogue forever (the SNES in Red's room: '...Okay! It's time to go!'). Reward must come from new tiles, not from activity.
Mashing A on the naming screen types 'A' as the name; the probe ends up with player 'A' and rival 'AA'. Harmless, but start RL from a saved state, not from boot.
Map id is already 38 (Red's room) during Oak's intro speech, so 'map == 38' doesn't mean the player can walk. Use context() plus a movement check.
Walking north out of Pallet Town triggers Oak's cutscene; the game is in a window/cutscene for ~100 presses until the starter is chosen.
The 'received CHARMANDER' jingle ignores input for ~3 seconds; actions during it are wasted, not harmful.
Party level/HP read 0 for a moment while the starter is being added.
RUN is useless in trainer battles; PKMN/ITEM menus are time sinks for a random policy in battle.

checkpoints.after_intro: Red's room, can walk, no Pokemon (probe.py, 124 presses from boot)
checkpoints.before_oak: Pallet Town north edge, Oak's 'Hey! Wait!' just triggered
checkpoints.lab_choose: Oak's lab, about to pick a starter
checkpoints.got_starter: Charmander L5 in party, rival dialogue done
checkpoints.battle_menu: Rival battle, 'Go! CHARMANDER!' just before the FIGHT menu
checkpoints.after_rival: Won the rival battle, Charmander L6, $3175, standing in the lab
